payload.text: devbin's next release, 0.1.27, carries everything open (directive 13), so vc sequences it with no scope question to hv. cc takes 0352 (medium: the core's word on how a workflow the candidate push starts derives the release's version and tag), then 0354 and 0358 (low), and files 0353's doc follow-up (lib/pages/new.md:20 does not say new never writes into another work tree) and Prodinfra's infra check handle advisory (hyphenated handles for domains sharing a first label, eg webble-me for webble.me; accept ${fqdn//./-}). dc takes 0355 (medium: seen again in Ccusage 0.1.10's first run today), then 0360 (medium) and 0359 (low), which share run_gate and so run one after another (decision 83), and files todo 214's release-machinery findings: a release.gates entry starting with release recurses (archived todo 203); macos and release call built-ins through the launcher (206); no macOS-stage rehearsal before a cut (207); a failed remote leg keeps its worktree on the host (208); dc's todo 67 TMPDIR leftovers; the 0311 traps_restore arm (helpers.bats:2558) reads HUP wrong under a nohup launcher. Each unit: a scratch tree off main, its own arms red at the base and green at the fix, booked on the Desk, a bank and a handover; vc lands it. 0.1.27's cut waits for hv's go: decision 182's pre-approval was spent on the cut that became 0.1.26. Todos 214 and 219 are carried here and archived.
